text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Clinical Experience and Effects There have been no reports of overdose with MYQORZO. Cardiovascular effects of overdose may include reduced LVEF, heart failure, and hypotension. Signs and symptoms of heart failure such as dyspnea, fatigue, leg edema, or elevations in NT-proBNP should prompt an evaluation of cardiac function [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ]. Management Discontinue MYQORZO treatment. Provide medically supportive measures to maintain hemodynamic stability and monitor left ventricular function. Consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-222-1222) or a medical toxicologist for additional overdose management recommendations.
